# Isaiah Chapter 17 -- The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

## Consensus Translation

*[Full consensus translation of all 14 verses]*

*Damascus and Ephraim's fall; gleaning remnant; forgotten God remembered; roaring nations rebuked*

---

## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah chapter 17 (Oracle Against Damascus) addresses damascus and ephraim's fall; gleaning remnant; forgotten god remembered; roaring nations rebuked. The key verse — "In that day man will look to his Maker" — captures the chapter's central message. This chapter belongs to First Isaiah (chs. 1-39), focused on judgment and the Assyrian crisis.
